weekly_objective: Capitalize on Thursday's clear weather for aerobic endurance while respecting that TSB, though improving, hasn't yet cleared the threshold for added intensity.
coach_says: Great news — TSB jumped 22.6 points and readiness is at 85 with balanced HRV, so the double day didn't dig the hole deeper. But TSB is still under -15 and your anaerobic load is well over target, so we're holding the line on intensity rather than adding a quality session. Instead we've reshuffled Thu/Fri around the weather: Thursday is the best riding day of the week, so the Z2 endurance ride moves there, and gym shifts to Friday. Weekend stays recovery-focused with rain confirmed.

days.details: 45 min restorative/yin yoga indoors — rain and 44 km/h winds rule out riding anyway. Focus: hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine, deep breathing. Goal is parasympathetic recovery and fresh legs for tomorrow's double day. No strength holds, no flow that raises heart rate.

days.session: AM hills tempo + PM hard MTB group ride (double day)
days.details: AM (road, ~60 min) | Primary objective: tempo/threshold hills to address aerobic-high shortage | Zone 3 to low Zone 4. Warm-up 15 min Z2 building. Main set: 3 x 8 min climbing at Z3-low Z4 (RPE 7), seated, controlled breathing, recover fully on descents (~5 min easy). Cool-down 10 min Z1. PM (~90 min): committed hard MTB group ride — go with the group, but given TSB -41.5 avoid contesting every sprint; ride strong on the sustained sections and sit in where you can. Fuel well between sessions (carbs at lunch, 60g/hr carbs on the evening ride).

Lunch swim, strictly recovery pace. Warmup: 200m easy freestyle, focus on long exhale. Main set: 4 x 100m easy (odd lengths drill — catch-up or fingertip drag — even lengths smooth swim), 20s rest; then 200m pull with buoy, relaxed. Cooldown: 200m very easy mixed strokes. Total: 1000m. Effort RPE 3 throughout — this flushes Tuesday's legs, nothing more.

Total 2 hrs | Primary objective: steady aerobic endurance | Zone 2 (RPE 4-5, conversational). Today is the clear-sky, moderate-wind day — best conditions of the week, so get this ride done now. Flat to rolling route, high cadence 90+ rpm, stay strictly in Z2 even on rises (shift down, don't push). No intervals. Fuel with 40-60g carbs/hr. TSB has improved but is still recovering, so keep this genuinely easy — if legs feel heavy, cap at 90 min.

days.session: Workout A — posterior chain & stability (reduced load)
days.details: Warm-up: 8 min — bike erg easy, glute bridges 2x10, band walks 2x10/side. Main: Romanian Deadlift 3x8 (moderate load, ~65-70% of usual, crisp form), Bulgarian Split Squat 3x8/leg (bodyweight or light DBs), Single-Leg Glute Bridge 3x10/leg, Pallof Press 3x10/side, Side Plank 3x30s/side. Rest 90s between sets. Objective: maintain posterior chain and hip stability without adding fatigue — loads deliberately reduced since anaerobic load is already over target this week. No heavy quad-dominant work, weekend is easy movement only so no timing conflict.

Forecast confirms rain through the weekend, so this is indoor recovery yoga rather than a walk. Gentle flow — hips, hamstrings, spine — heart rate stays low throughout, no structured effort. Purpose is circulation and movement quality while continuing to bank the TSB gains from earlier in the week.

Complete rest — rain forecast makes this an easy call and it lets the strong TSB recovery consolidate rather than get eroded. Prioritise 8+ hrs sleep, good food, hydration. Optional 15 min gentle stretching in the evening. Arriving at next week fresher and with anaerobic load settled will let us safely reintroduce quality work.
